content:
You write the short text of a strength-training app's weekly report. The app already shows every number, chart and the reason under each piece of advice; you add two things.

Period: 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-04 (one week, 7 days).
Status, decided by code: progressing (main lifts: 5 up, 0 flat, 0 down).
Sessions: 6 of 6 planned. Sets: 74 (last week 74).
Main lifts, best set this week:
- 槓鈴臥推: 80 kg x 8 (last week 77.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 3.2%, 8 sets this week
- 深蹲: 100 kg x 6 (last week 97.5 kg x 6), estimated 1RM up 2.6%, 8 sets this week
- 槓鈴划船: 70 kg x 8 (last week 67.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 3.7%, 8 sets this week
- 羅馬尼亞硬舉: 90 kg x 8 (last week 87.5 kg x 8), estimated 1RM up 2.9%, 8 sets this week
- 腿推機: 160 kg x 10 (last week 157.5 kg x 10), estimated 1RM up 1.6%, 6 sets this week
New records (best estimated 1RM so far; not necessarily a new weight): 槓鈴臥推 80 kg x 8; 深蹲 100 kg x 6; 槓鈴划船 70 kg x 8; 羅馬尼亞硬舉 90 kg x 8; 腿推機 160 kg x 10.
Sets per muscle this week, where a muscle an exercise trains on the side counts half a set (range 10-20 a week for 胸, 背, 肩中束, 肩後束, 股四頭, 腿後側, 臀, 二頭, 三頭; the others have no range): 胸 14 (last week 14), 背 22 (above the range; last week 22), 肩前束 7 (last week 7), 肩中束 4 (below the range; last week 4), 肩後束 10 (last week 10), 股四頭 14 (last week 14), 腿後側 12 (last week 12), 臀 22 (above the range; last week 22), 二頭 13 (last week 13), 三頭 11 (last week 11), 小腿 2 (last week 2).
No body weight logged.
Weights are in kg; write every weight in kg.
The user's goal: "增肌".
The user's note for this week (context to fit the advice to, not a message that needs a reply): "側平舉的時候右肩會卡卡的，有點痛".
Rules that fired, most important first; each has one or more items:
- low_volume (priority 50). Advice: It takes addSets more sets each week to bring the muscle to 10 a week. Offer the options in its data for the user to choose between, as given, with their exercises and set counts; if there is only one, give it alone (an option is left out when it isn't a sensible one, not because nothing trains the muscle). Add no exercise of your own unless the note rules an option out.
    - 肩中束: data {"muscle":"肩中束","options":["6 more sets each week of 側平舉, on top of the sets they do now","add 繩索側平舉, a new exercise, for 6 sets each week"],"sets":4,"previousPerWeek":4,"target":10,"addSets":6}

1. headline: one sentence the user reads first, the most important thing about this week, consistent with the status. It may use a number from above. At most 40 characters.
2. actions: one for each rule above. Each says exactly what to do next week about every item under its rule, naming each one as written above (every muscle, every lift), with the exercise, sets, weights or reps from the data; as short as covering every item allows. Don't repeat the reason; the app shows it. Fit every action to the user's note: if it mentions pain or discomfort in a movement or joint, don't simply add sets or load there; suggest a pain-free alternative or a lighter range, and getting it checked if it persists.

Use only the numbers above; never invent data. No myths, no diagnosis, no scolding. Plain text only: no Markdown, no lists inside a field. Write in Traditional Chinese (繁體中文, Taiwan usage) with full-width punctuation (，。！？「」), and use the Chinese exercise and muscle names given above.
